title: Monitoring Threshold
description: A conservation threshold rule defining the acceptable value range for an environmental parameter at a heritage monitoring point or zone (SOSA ObservableProperty + QUDT units).

id.description: Persistent URI identifying this threshold rule.

type.description: Fixed type token identifying this record as a monitoring threshold (maps to sosa:ObservableProperty).

parameter.description: URI of the observable environmental parameter, preferably a GEOSS Essential Climate Variable (ECV) URI or a QUDT QuantityKind URI (e.g. https://qudt.org/vocab/quantitykind/Temperature for temperature).

thresholdType.description: The kind of threshold constraint: minValue (lower bound only), maxValue (upper bound only), range (both bounds), rateOfChange (maximum acceptable rate of change per unit time).

minValue.description: Lower bound of the acceptable range (required when thresholdType is minValue or range).

maxValue.description: Upper bound of the acceptable range (required when thresholdType is maxValue or range).

rateValue.description: Maximum acceptable rate of change per unit time (required when thresholdType is rateOfChange).

unit.description: QUDT unit URI for the threshold value(s), e.g. https://qudt.org/vocab/unit/DEG_C for degrees Celsius or https://qudt.org/vocab/unit/PERCENT for relative humidity.

severity.description: Alert severity level triggered when the threshold is breached: advisory (informational), warning (attention required), alarm (action required), critical (emergency response required).

appliesTo.description: URI of the monitoring point (ogc.heritage.monitoring-point) or heritage zone (ogc.heritage.heritage-site) to which this threshold applies.

activePeriod.description: Optional date range during which this threshold is in force (e.g. seasonal).

start.description: Start date of the active period (ISO 8601).

end.description: End date of the active period (ISO 8601).

source.description: URI or label of the technical standard, conservation protocol or expert opinion from which the threshold value is derived (e.g. EN 15757 climate specification).

rationale.description: Free-text explanation of the basis for the threshold value.

reviewDate.description: Date on which this threshold is scheduled for review (ISO 8601).
